dedupe_keys.name: ouvrages de protection littorale de 2e rang

description: Ouvrages de protection littorale de 2e rang is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Location and identification of 2nd rank coastal protection structures diagnosed during the PAPI BSA inventory. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "2nd row coastal protection works" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inondation, Risque naturel, tempête, lutte contre les inondations, crue, modélisation. The listing shows 2015-10-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
